title: Services overview
description: Every workload ranked by trouble; drills into the Service dashboard.

panels.title: Workloads, worst first
panels.description: One row per Deployment, StatefulSet and DaemonSet, sorted by restarts, then memory against limit, then error log lines. Click a workload for its Service dashboard. Blank memory or CPU means no limit is set; blank 5xx means no Traefik service routes to it.

targets.expr: group by (namespace, workload) (max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) or label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) or label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)") or label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)") or label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"))

sum by (namespace, workload) ((max_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[$__range]) - min_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[$__range])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(max_over_time(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}[$__range]), "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(max_over_time(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) or label_replace(max_over_time(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")))

max by (namespace, workload, reason) (topk by (namespace, workload) (1, kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_timestamp > 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) or label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")))) * 1000

max by (namespace, workload) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD"}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) or label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")))

sum by (namespace, workload) (sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) or label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")))

max by (namespace, workload) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) or label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")))

sum by (namespace, workload) (label_join(group by (namespace, workload) (max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) or label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))), "svc", "-", "namespace", "workload") * on (svc) group_left () (sum by (svc) (label_replace(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]), "svc", "$1", "service", "(.+)-([0-9a-f]{20}|[0-9]+)@kubernetes(crd)?")) or sum by (svc) (label_replace(rate(traefik_service_requests_total[$__rate_interval]), "svc", "$1", "service", "(.+)-([0-9a-f]{20}|[0-9]+)@kubernetes(crd)?")) * 0))
